author: su-1c97c55a-dafc-4d85-a013-26f71bcec5a5
summary: The configured full arms had placements after 10, 3 and 1 valid due rows; brief-only placed after 7; baseline was censored after 4. These are recorded placement associations. They do not establish an instruction effect: workloads and holders changed, instruction exposure is not verified, and most configured full-arm reminders did not fire. This report does not establish the required matched, exposed-arm comparison or clear R-4 acceptance.

sources.role: Corrected historical per-holder metrics; supersedes the initial metrics export.
Read-only collector procedure and exact arm boundaries; collector build ac5e5daf51.
Full-w4 placement receipt and census, including explicit unverified brief delivery.
Trial custody, configured arms, opportunity rules, exclusions, censoring and ratified outcomes.

Independent historical metric measurement and disclosed confounds. Its blanket ideation-failure wording must not override the corrected export: the short su-e1774015 brief-only span is rated pass there.

metricSemantics.plansWritten: Successful holder plans:new or plan-producing route-idea calls settled within the holder window, per readHolderPlanToolCounts. This is not a count of completed work cycles.
metricSemantics.reports: Goal-stamped owner report rows in the historical collector. Counts alone establish neither complete report content nor reporting timeliness.
metricSemantics.reminders: Agent-obligation awaits created within the holder window with expires_ts set. fired counts non-null fired_at; cancelled counts non-null cancelled_at. These lifetime settlement fields are not proof that the model read a reminder within the trial window.
metricSemantics.placementGeneration: goalPlacementTurnEnd.rows[].sourceGeneration is the placement obligation generation. It must not be relabelled as a rendered instruction generation.
metricSemantics.cost: The historical reports.costNotMeasured field is a report-quality classification, not inference spend. It cannot establish a per-arm dollar cost.
metricSemantics.loop: Historical deliveredFires counts rearmed routine transitions. It must not be described as transcript-verified instruction delivery.

missedDuties.observation: Valid due rows and historical overdue-cluster metrics are available. Due-at-turn-end rows alone are not independently adjudicated missed obligations.

verifiedCompletedCycles.observation: Placement events and plansWritten do not establish complete verified work cycles.

reportContentAndTimeliness.observation: Historical report counts and quality classifications are preserved; complete report content, scheduled deadlines and receipt-based timeliness are not adjudicated here.

launchChoices.observation: Ratified target-plan placement events are preserved. Equivalent offered alternatives and refusal opportunities across arms are not established.

effectBackedBoundaries.observation: Closed/censored arm boundaries follow their governing decisions; comparable resource, model and workload exposure is not established.

falseInterventions.observation: Await cancellation counts are not a false-intervention oracle.

latency.observation: Opportunity counts before placement are available. Baseline and full-p2 are censored; their observed counts must not be treated as completed-placement latency.

inferenceCost.observation: No arm-attributed inference ledger with consult/orphan-session inclusion was verified. Neither holderCalls nor report-quality cost fields substitute for spend.

verification.procedure: Read the current R-4 clause/rubric and metric writers; hash the source artifacts; independently rerun the closed baseline/full-w4 census over created_at > start AND created_at <= end, separating window-orphans; read exact fleet-launch invocation 31298800.

closedCensus.result: Reproduces the ratified opportunity counts in D-061/D-063.

endpointReceipt.explanation: projected-tool-deps stamps invoked_at at dispatch settlement. The receipt falls after the effect-bounded arm end, explaining why the historical full-w4 tool-count metric is zero despite the canonical placement event.

verification.correctedExport: Use the revision export, not the first export, for ideation verdicts. Do not repeat the blanket claim that every holder span failed ideation.

confounds: Sequential windows on one live goal, five holders, and a changing backlog do not establish equivalent isolated workloads.
Full-p1 and brief-only each changed holder; the metric collector splits them into holder spans.
Ideation metrics cover the goal-day ending at each holder-window end, so adjacent windows overlap and must not be summed.
Configured arms and obligation source generations do not prove the rendered instruction generation or model exposure.
The full-arm reminder lifetime totals are 43 created, 2 fired and 41 cancelled; these do not establish delivery of the reminder treatment within each window.
Historical report classifications predate the current spend-aware metric implementation; they are not fresh ratings under that implementation.
The baseline census records missed opportunities without a target placement, not a zero-duration completed placement.

review.scope: Read report, D-065, metric writers and source hashes. Did not independently recensus the database or reread the original launch invocation.
review.verdict: Approved as an inconclusive descriptive record; P-028/P-004 and primary live binding remain uncleared.

remaining: Verified instruction-generation/exposure receipts and matched model/resource/workload opportunities before any claimed causal effect.
The missing required comparison dimensions, or an owner-approved acceptance rescope through the existing amendment mechanism.
